answer_1.quote: We evaluate the effectiveness of our method across three scenarios: detoxification, resisting jailbreaking, and responding more positively.

answer_2.quote: Model surgery significantly reduces the toxicity of the base model while keeping its core performance. We also report performance on GSM8K (EM), BBH (EM), MMLU (EM), TydiQA (F1), and WikiText (ppl).

answer_3.quote: We test our method on jailbreak prompts using string matching ... and prompting GPT-4 to examine. We also employed ChatGPT to assess the models' ability to maintain positive attitudes.
